text:
max: CloudArc sent a draft solution brief + marketplace tile. They want the partner lockup on the hero. Can marketing confirm assets meet brand rules?

emily-marketing: Got it. Which logo version do they want? Full color or white?

claire (CloudArc): We prefer full-color horizontal on white for the hero, white-on-dark for social. Our guideline: 14px clearspace, no alpha in PNG.

raj-eng: Note: the brief mentions a "3x throughput" stat. Ops/legal will want a test appendix or we should rephrase.

max: Proposed quote: "Redwood + CloudArc improved inference latency and lowered cost." Claire, ok?

claire (CloudArc): Fine. Legal asks to change "lowered" to "improved" cost efficiency. Also upload brand permission PDF.

legal-bot: Reminder: attach signed permission doc to #legal-approvals. Performance claims need either a test matrix or non-numeric wording.

emily-marketing: I'll produce hero (1200x600 PNG sRGB no alpha) and a 600x600 tile. Will swap numeric claims to non-numeric language. Target publish next Wednesday if legal approves.

max: Thanks. Claire, please send the permission PDF and SVG lockup. Raj, remove numeric callout from page 3.

claire (CloudArc): Uploaded cloudarc-logos.svg and permission-v2.pdf to share.

raj-eng: Removed the benchmark image and added an architecture diagram.

emily-marketing: Drafts ready, sharing in creative channel for internal review. Moving to #legal-approvals now.

max: Great work team. Tracking actions: emily -> export PNGs, claire -> confirm legal doc, raj -> finalize doc.

legal-bot: Thread moved to #legal-approvals (ref 1785000000).
